verdict.line: You lose if you auto into an up Riposte or try to out-race her Duelist healing with autos alone; you win if you chain Q stacks into W's stun and punish the window after she burns both Lunge charges.

brief.thesis: Fiora's W (Riposte) only answers basic attacks, not ability damage, so this lane is decided by whether K'Sante trades with Q (Ntofo Strikes) and W (Path Maker) or feeds her free parries with autos. The matchup sits at 47.5% over 2,196 games, confirming it's genuinely even rather than favored either way.

theirWindow.when: Riposte is up and she activates it
theirWindow.what: She gains bonus Attack Damage and parries your next basic attack, negating the trade entirely. Hold autos and poke with Q's line damage or charge W instead until her 10/9/8/7/6s cooldown is down.

yourWindow.when: She's just used both Lunge charges
yourWindow.what: Fiora's Q (Lunge) can reactivate once more within a couple seconds for free, but after that she has no gap-closer up. Dash in with E (Footwork) or commit your all-in while she's stuck walking.

start.why: Picked in 75.9% of games for a reason: the extra sustain keeps you even in the early poke race against her Duelist passive healing.

boots.why: Run in 84.3% of games here; it directly cuts the physical damage from her autos and E (Burst of Speed)-empowered attack speed windows.

core.why: Grievous Wounds early cuts into her Duelist passive healing before she can stack it in extended trades.
Core in the highest-winrate path (57.5% over 127 games); the slow-on-hit pairs with Q's own slow to lock her down.
More Grievous Wounds uptime against an all-physical, sustain-reliant duelist.
Completes the 57.5% winrate path, giving the resistances to survive once she's stacked E move speed and is diving in.

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustained health growth directly counters her sustain-race plan built around Duelist passive stacking.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite posts the highest winrate in the data (49.6%) for this matchup; the burn cuts directly into the healing from her Duelist passive during all-ins, which matters more here than Teleport's lane reset.

playing.title: Hold autos when Riposte is up
playing.detail: Her W (Riposte) parries your next basic attack while active. Trade with Q (Ntofo Strikes) line damage and ability combos instead of feeding her a free parry.

playing.title: Stack Q before committing
playing.detail: Q grants a stack on hit and fires a pulling shockwave at 2 stacks. Land two Qs to drag her in before you go for anything else.

playing.title: Charge W outside her Lunge range
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) takes reduced damage while charging, but her Q (Lunge) still reaches 600 range during the channel. Start the charge just outside that distance when you can.

playing.title: Punish after her double-Lunge
playing.detail: Fiora's Q can reactivate once more for free within a couple seconds. Once both charges are burned she has no gap-closer up — dash in with E (Footwork).

playing.title: Save All Out to finish, not start
playing.detail: R (All Out) knocks her through terrain and transforms your kit, but it also lowers your defenses. Use it to close out a trade you're already winning.

playing.title: Build into her sustain, not just armor
playing.detail: Bramble Vest and Thornmail's Grievous Wounds cut her Duelist healing directly, which matters more than raw armor stacking against her.

playing.title: Track her E move-speed stacks
playing.detail: Burst of Speed stacks move speed per attack or Lunge landed and fully refreshes on a kill. Disengage once she's stacked rather than trying to outrun her.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and the win-rate figures above come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reading of cooldowns, stacks, and trade windows is my own analysis layered on top.
